id.description: The identifier elementor-global-class-list reports for the class to change.

label.description: Optional. The new name for this class. Must not repeat a label another class on this site already uses.

styles.description: Optional. The style properties to set at the desktop breakpoint. A property named here is set, a property not named is left alone, and a property sent as null is removed from the class.

classDigest.description: A digest over the whole global class set and its order as stored, which is what verification compares.

classCount.description: How many global classes this site holds. This operation never changes it.
